nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages deployment
nodes.rationale: Empty build command, output dir /; every push to main deploys live.

nodes.label: GPX / FIT export and JSON backup
nodes.norm_label: gpx / fit export and json backup

nodes.label: Native FIT binary parser (msg 20 records, msg 19 laps)
nodes.norm_label: native fit binary parser (msg 20 records, msg 19 laps)

nodes.label: Hard-coded SUPABASE constant
nodes.rationale: Supabase URL and publishable key are hard-coded on purpose: site is private and must not be pointable at another project. Do not make configurable again.

nodes.label: No build step / zero-build app
nodes.rationale: Plain browser scripts served via python http.server; no package.json, bundler or test suite; testing by hand in browser.

nodes.label: delete_expired_requests() SQL function (pg_cron)
nodes.rationale: Pending registrations auto-delete after 24h.

nodes.label: Users delete own rides RLS policy
nodes.norm_label: users delete own rides rls policy
nodes.rationale: Without a delete policy Supabase silently deletes nothing.

nodes.label: Row Level Security for rides (auth.uid()::text = user_id)
nodes.norm_label: row level security for rides (auth.uid()::text = user_id)
nodes.rationale: user_id is text, so compare against auth.uid()::text; upsert needs insert and update.

nodes.label: Shared global scope (no modules)
nodes.rationale: All files share one global scope; inline onclick= markup calls globals, so renaming a function breaks the markup.

nodes.label: Optimistic delete with RLS verification
nodes.rationale: Delete uses .select(id) to see what was removed because RLS without a delete policy returns no error but deletes nothing; re-hydrates what cloud kept.

nodes.label: Fingerprint column, backfill & unique index SQL
nodes.norm_label: fingerprint column, backfill & unique index sql
nodes.rationale: Unique index on (user_id, fingerprint) makes DB reject duplicates.

nodes.label: Ride fingerprint duplicate detection
nodes.rationale: t:<start epoch> or g:<first>|<last>|<distance> for untimed routes; must match README SQL backfill.

nodes.label: Hydrated runtime ride (cum, simp, smap, thumb, layers)
nodes.norm_label: hydrated runtime ride (cum, simp, smap, thumb, layers)
nodes.rationale: New ride fields must be added to toRecord, hydrate and the syncToSupabase payload.

nodes.label: Stored ride record (IndexedDB ridecomp_v1 / JSON backup)
nodes.norm_label: stored ride record (indexeddb ridecomp_v1 / json backup)
nodes.rationale: Store names keep old RideComp naming so existing users data loads; owner field is local-only, never sent to Supabase.

nodes.label: STATS_VER stats versioning
nodes.rationale: Stats recomputed when stats.v !== STATS_VER; bump after changing computeStats.

nodes.label: Debounced refresh render pipeline
nodes.rationale: refresh() debounced 16ms runs applyMapStyles -> renderFeed -> renderView; charts destroyed and rebuilt each render.

nodes.label: Map-first layout: glass sidebar / mobile bottom sheet
nodes.norm_label: map-first layout: glass sidebar / mobile bottom sheet
nodes.rationale: Under 768px the panel becomes a draggable bottom sheet (peek/half/full).

nodes.label: View state machine (list / detail / compare)
nodes.rationale: renderView empties hidden views so their elements do not shadow the active view; canvases are looked up inside the view element, never by global id.

nodes.label: Cloud as source of truth when signed in
nodes.norm_label: cloud as source of truth when signed in
nodes.rationale: Signed-in users see exactly cloud rows; IndexedDB read only for guests or when cloud load fails offline.

nodes.label: Tile key probing & free-tile fallback
nodes.rationale: Bad keys return 401/403 with a placeholder image so tileerror never fires; probe one tile with fetch().

nodes.label: No CARTO tiles rule
nodes.rationale: basemaps.cartocdn.com serves an API KEY REQUIRED image with HTTP 200.
